product_overview: Catewebs is a multilingual web design and development website that presents the company’s services, pricing, and contact options. Visitors can browse the site in English or Spanish, switch themes, and submit inquiries through a contact form.
core_goals: Browse the company homepage and learn what Catewebs offers
Switch between English and Spanish content
Contact the company through the contact form or external messaging links

features.name: Navigation
features.description: Lets visitors move between the main public pages and access the site from the header, including on mobile.
user_flows: Navigate to /en -> Open the mobile menu -> Close the mobile menu -> Follow a navigation link to another public page -> See the destination page
Navigate to /en -> Follow a navigation link to the pricing page -> See the pricing page
Navigate to /en -> Follow a navigation link to the services page -> See the services page
Navigate to /en -> Follow a navigation link to the about page -> See the about page
Navigate to /en -> Follow a navigation link to the contact page -> See the contact page

features.name: Language Switching
features.description: Allows visitors to switch the website between English and Spanish.
user_flows: Navigate to /en -> Open the language selector -> Choose Spanish -> See the page reload in Spanish
Navigate to /es -> Open the language selector -> Choose English -> See the page reload in English

features.name: Theme Switching
features.description: Lets visitors toggle the site appearance between dark and light mode.
user_flows: Navigate to /en -> Toggle the theme setting -> See the site switch between dark and light mode
Navigate to /en/contact -> Toggle the theme setting -> See the contact page switch between dark and light mode

features.name: Homepage Hero and Call to Action
features.description: Shows the main value proposition, service highlights, and quick actions to contact the company.
user_flows: Navigate to /en -> View the hero section and service highlights -> Follow the Telegram call to action -> See the external messaging destination
Navigate to /en -> View the hero section and service highlights -> Follow the contact form call to action -> See the contact page

features.name: Instagram Embed
features.description: Displays embedded Instagram content on the homepage with a link out to Instagram.
user_flows: Navigate to /en -> View the embedded Instagram content -> Follow the Instagram link -> See the external Instagram destination

features.name: Services Listing
features.description: Displays the company’s service categories with images and descriptions.
user_flows: Navigate to /en/services -> View the service cards with images and descriptions
Navigate to /es/services -> View the service cards with images and descriptions in Spanish

features.name: Pricing Plans Display
features.description: Shows three public pricing tiers with feature lists and a contact call to action.
user_flows: Navigate to /en/pricing -> View the three pricing tiers and their feature lists
Navigate to /en/pricing -> Review a plan tier -> Follow the Telegram call to action -> See the external messaging destination
Navigate to /es/pricing -> View the three pricing tiers and their feature lists in Spanish

features.name: Contact Form
features.description: Provides a public form for visitors to send a message with basic validation on the entered details.
user_flows: Navigate to /en/contact -> Fill in name -> Fill in email -> Fill in phone number -> Fill in message -> Submit the form -> See a success message
Navigate to /en/contact -> Leave required fields invalid -> Submit the form -> See validation error messages
Navigate to /es/contact -> Fill in name -> Fill in email -> Fill in phone number -> Fill in message -> Submit the form -> See a success message

routes.description: Homepage with hero section, service cards, Instagram embed, and CTA buttons
About page with company description and logo
Pricing page with 3 plan tiers (Basic, Standard, Premium)
Services page listing web development, marketing, SEO, design, e-commerce, and system design
Contact page with contact information and a contact form

features.name: Navigation
features.description: Header with navigation links to all pages, mobile hamburger menu, and social media links
user_interactions: Click navigation links (Home, Pricing, Services, About, Contact)
Open mobile menu via hamburger icon
Click CTA button in mobile menu

features.name: Language Switching
features.description: Switch between English and Spanish locales via dropdown in header

features.name: Theme Switching
features.description: Toggle between dark and light mode
user_interactions: Page switches between dark and light mode

features.name: Contact Form
features.description: Form to send a message with name, email, phone, and message fields with Zod validation
user_interactions: See validation error messages on invalid input
See error message on failed submission

features.name: Pricing Plans Display
features.description: Display three pricing tiers with features list and CTA buttons linking to Telegram
user_interactions: Click CTA button to contact via Telegram

features.name: Services Listing
features.description: Display six service cards with images and descriptions
user_interactions: View service cards with images and descriptions

features.name: Homepage Hero and CTA
features.description: Hero section with title, subtitle, and call-to-action buttons linking to Telegram and contact form
user_interactions: View hero section with title and subtitle

features.name: Instagram Embed
features.description: Embedded Instagram content section on homepage

known_limitations.issue: Contact form submission is simulated with a timeout, not connected to a real backend API
known_limitations.impact: Form submissions are not actually sent or persisted

known_limitations.issue: Memory leak in ContactForm due to setInterval without cleanup in useEffect
known_limitations.impact: Console logging continues indefinitely after component unmounts
